verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk data export, an open-format download (CSV, JSON, XML), or an account-exit path for Zoho Invoice. Saving individual invoices as PDF and running reports are adjacent document features, not a full data export. The API probes returned 404s and show no export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
